item.tib: dbal mo las kyi mtha' bsdu drag po'i sbyin sreg drag blug
item.coloph: ces pa 'di yang stag la'i thugs sprul kho bo dbra khyung rgyud 'dzin 7g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal dbyings kyi gsang mtshan dbal 'bar stag slag can bdag la gter bdag yum sras sde lngas lung bstan te/ sa pho sprel gyi hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig gi nyin par gyim shod shel le brag rdzong nas gter las drangs pa'o//
